definition.name: Create Rooms And Balustrades From Table
definition.description: Places railings and room separation lines along balcony edges and places named rooms from mm points, merging points that fall in an existing room.
definition.aiDescription: Places railings and room separation lines along balcony edges and places named rooms from mm points, merging points that fall in an existing room.
examples: Add glass balustrades and room separation lines on the 8 Block C balcony edges, place named rooms (Level 2 to Level 3) with unit in Department, merging open-plan spaces, and flip the CH-2 door hand.
